children: There is a strong floor under gold prices around $3,800/oz, according to BMI, a unit of Fitch Solutions. While the precious metal faces pressure from U.S. dollar strength and "a hawkish turn in U.S. Fed policy," geopolitical risks remain high and central bank purchases of gold continue, it says. BMI reiterates a 2026 average gold-price forecast of $4,400/oz. The price has averaged $4,555/oz year to date, it says. Spot gold is down 0.4% at $4,340.65/oz. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
